brief.ask: Art-direct "Cedar of Lebanon Canopy" — #18 of the 72 Ambo church visualizers (Calm Contemporary Worship lyric visualizer, Collection I of 72; subgenre Scenic Nature). Premise: Sun-dappled forest light filtering through horizontal ancient cedar boughs. Warm emerald and gold sunbeams filter down through tiered horizontal Cedar of Lebanon boughs, casting dancing dappled forest bokeh. Lighting today: Key: 4800K forest canopy sunlight with emerald leaf translucency. Service use: Psalms, strength & rootedness in Christ, creation worship. Audio mapping today: Swell → Widens sun-dappled forest light shafts; Vocal → Gently sways horizontal cedar boughs and emerald bokeh; Shimmer → Sparkles golden pollen motes in the sunbeams. Palette: #07120E #183629 #C9A24D #F4F7EC. Keep the id, name, premise and palette; rebuild the direction: the geometry and depth planes, typography for the worship lyric band (one line at a time, four to five seconds a line, word-by-word progression), image logic (how the procedural scene (no concept plate: the plate is generative, in code) and the procedural scene meet), texture, motion, and which audio channel drives what. Decide it — the lead's lens will drive the kit's material weave and optical pass for this one.
brief.audience: Congregations watching a projector or LED wall from the pews, five to forty metres away, eyes on the words; and the worship leader or volunteer running Ambo live from a laptop.
brief.feeling: Stillness and reverence — a sanctuary that breathes with the singer's voice; gorgeous, slow, never a screensaver.
constraints: Build method (fixed): a real-time Canvas 2D audio-reactive renderer in Plajah's worship visualizer kit — sanctuary background, multi-plane depth (god rays, motes, bokeh), the kit's Council optical pass (35mm light leaks, anamorphic flare, film grain, colour punch, and a tactile material weave keyed to the LEAD director's lens) and the kit's lyric / scripture typography engine. No video playback, no WebGL, no assets beyond the one concept plate.

Audio drives amplitude, colour, light, growth and glow only — never the position of the words. Envelopes are smoothed; nothing strobes or flashes (photosensitive-safe); uptempo pulses are spring-damped.

The reading band is sacred: lyrics or scripture must stay legible at 1920×1080 and 4K from the back pew, over the busiest moment of the scene. A text-safe dimming band is part of the kit; direct how the scene yields to it.

Typefaces are fixed to the kit's open-licensed set: Noto Serif (text serif), Outfit / Inter (sans), Cinzel (display), JetBrains Mono. Direct scale, case, tracking, measure and hierarchy, not new families.

Sacred imagery is used correctly and respectfully: biblical places and objects are specific and attributable, never costume; nothing denominational or branded; nothing that reads as a music video or a screensaver.
Runs at 60 fps on an integrated-GPU laptop driving a projector: favour layered gradients, cached textures and a few large shapes over particle storms.
Keep this visualizer's id, name, premise and four-colour palette. The council owns the direction, not the catalogue entry.
references: No concept plate: the scene is built entirely in code from the premise.
Sample lyric lines on the band: "Be still my soul the Lord is on thy side" / "Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain".

proposals.title: Cedar of Lebanon Canopy
proposals.idea: A sun-dappled forest canopy, with a slow, rhythmic, and textural glow, that evokes quiet reverence.
proposals.geometry: Layered, concentric circles that grow progressively smaller from a central point, mirroring the tiers of the cedar boughs.
proposals.typography: Noto Serif for the scripture, a sans serif for the lyric, with a simple, legible scale.
proposals.imageLogic: A continuous procedural scene with soft, dappled light and shimmering particles, gradually modulated by the audio.
proposals.texture: A textured, yet still, material weave that evokes a sense of depth and realism, achieved with procedural shaders.
proposals.motion: Soft, fluid movement of light and particles, responding to the audio cues, with a subtle emphasis on growth and glow.
proposals.productionMethod: Generative, procedural visual scene rendered with a focus on layering and texture to create the desired mood.
proposals.humanTrace: Simulated, textured, organic materials mimicking wood grain, with subtle light leaks and anamorphic flare mimicking real-world film stock.
proposals.risk: The risk is that the visual could feel too abstract or overly generic, leading to a lack of specificity and emotional connection.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist may overemphasize a dramatic effect with a focus on color and light, potentially losing the subtle, textured aesthetic.

proposals.title: Cedar Canopy Forest
proposals.idea: A sun-dappled forest canopy filtered through horizontal cedar branches, creating a warm and ethereal visual experience.
proposals.geometry: A grid of tiered horizontal cedar branches, with a subtle gradient in their width and depth.
proposals.typography: The worship lyric band is set against a subtle gradient of warm and cool colors, with larger characters for emphasis.
proposals.imageLogic: Photographs of the cedar branches and forest floor are used as textures, with subtle lighting and shadows to create depth.
proposals.texture: The surface of the forest floor is textured with subtle light leaks and film grain, while the cedar branches have a subtle metallic sheen.
proposals.motion: The sun-dappled forest light shafts sway gently with the singer's voice, creating a sense of movement and emotion.
proposals.productionMethod: The forest canopy is rendered using generative image/video models with procedural code, with subtle lighting and shadows added to create depth.
proposals.humanTrace: The perceptible sign of making is the subtle textures and light leaks in the forest floor and cedar branches.
proposals.risk: The risk is that the visual may become too cluttered or busy, overwhelming the worship leader or volunteer running Ambo live.

synthesis.direction: Geometry: Layered, concentric circles for the cedar boughs, evoking depth and realism. Typography: Use Noto Serif for scripture and Inter for lyrics, with a legible, elegant scale. Image: A continuous procedural scene with soft, dappled light and shimmering particles, gradually modulated by audio. Texture: A textured, yet still, material weave that mimics wood grain with subtle light leaks. Motion: Soft, fluid movement of light and particles, with a subtle emphasis on growth and glow, driven by audio cues.
synthesis.keepFromCounterpoint: The sun-dappled forest light shafts sway gently with the singer's voice, creating a sense of movement and emotion.
synthesis.editorCut: Integrating a dynamic, organic material weave that combines the layered gradients and textures from both proposals, ensuring the visualizer remains smooth and responsive. Adding a dynamic glow pass that modulates the color and intensity of the bokeh based on the singer's voice, enhancing the emotional impact.
synthesis.openDecision: Decide whether the dynamic light shafts and gentle sway of the cedar boughs should be driven by the audio or a combination of audio and visual cues to enhance the worship experience.
synthesis.ariaSummary: The council debated between a more abstract, rhythmic and textural approach and a more cluttered, ethereal one. WORLD_ECLECTIC won on geometry and texture, while BAROQUE impressed with its motion and emotional depth. I recommend a balanced approach, combining the best of both with a dynamic glow pass and a nuanced material weave.

comparison: They agree on using a sun-dappled forest canopy and procedural generation. They differ on the complexity of the geometry and the texture. WORLD_ECLECTIC is stronger on geometry and texture, while BAROQUE has a better sense of motion.
